failed.name: all empty count forms keep captions without empty indicators or stale status titles

rootCause: The single VNode clone branch has no owning DOM for Fragment/text/multiple-root components and drops indicator classes/title. Count and caption visibility were coupled; generic isRenderable does not model Vue empty content. Existing native content class/style assertions are retained; only semantic marker ownership moves to the native indicator per ADR0007.
